source_prompt: Ultra-detailed surreal pharmaceutical research laboratory at twilight, wide cinematic 16:9 composition. Center: a translucent teal glass molecular model of a double-helix drug scaffold floating above a brushed-steel bench, with glowing cyan bond lines and amber atom nodes. Left: a wall-sized holographic dashboard titled "EvidenceGrade AI" in bold white sans-serif, showing a 5-tier grade ladder (A emerald, B teal, C gold, D orange, F crimson) and a line chart labeled "Citation Confidence 2019-2026". Right: a large arched window revealing a rainy neo-Tokyo street with neon kanji signs reflecting on wet asphalt, a red umbrella leaning against the window sill, and a black cat silhouette on the ledge. Foreground: an open leather notebook with handwritten notes "CYP3A4 interaction risk" and a fountain pen, next to a white ceramic coffee cup with a teal lid and a cracked porcelain saucer. Ceiling: brass articulated lamps casting warm pools of light; one lamp has a green glass shade. Background shelves: amber glass reagent bottles labeled Aspirin, Warfarin, Ibuprofen in clean black type, a vintage brass microscope, and a small potted monstera plant with one yellow leaf. Atmosphere: volumetric god-rays through rain-streaked glass, subtle film grain, high dynamic range, teal-and-amber complementary color grade, no logos of real companies, no watermarks, photorealistic mixed with holographic UI.

results.reconstructed_prompt:
Wide 16:9 cinematic, photorealistic 3D render of a moody pharmaceutical research laboratory overlooking a rainy neon-lit city at night. Dark teal walls, brushed stainless-steel work surfaces, warm brass fixtures, turquoise holographic light, subtle atmospheric haze.

On the left, a large transparent upright holographic display outlined in cyan, viewed at a slight angle. Its bold white heading reads “EvidenceGrade AI”, with “5-tier grade” beneath. Five vertically stacked outlined grading boxes contain large letters: “A” in green, “B” in cyan, “C” in yellow, “D” in orange, and “F” in pink-red. Beside them is a white-grid line chart titled “Citation Confidence 2019-2026”, with the same wording along the bottom, a vertical scale labeled 0 through 60 in increments of 10, and a jagged cyan line rising from the lower left toward the upper right.

Centered above the laboratory table, a floating luminous molecular DNA double helix made of translucent turquoise glass spheres and glowing cyan connecting rods, punctuated by metallic gold atoms. A small polygonal molecular branch extends from its lower right. Soft cyan reflections spill onto the metal tabletop.

In the background, two wall-mounted shelves hold amber medicine bottles with white labels, including readable “Aspirin”, “Warfarin”, and “Ibuprofen”, along with pale binders and small glass laboratory containers. Below the shelves, an antique brass microscope stands left of center; a potted monstera with green and yellow split leaves stands to the right. Overhead, articulated industrial brass lamp arms support downward-facing shades, including a prominent green enamel shade at upper right and dark bronze shades with warm glowing bulbs.

The right side features a tall arched black-framed window covered in rain streaks, looking onto densely packed buildings and pink, red, and cyan vertical neon signs reflected on wet streets. The Chinese sign lettering is too indistinct to transcribe reliably. A small black cat sits in silhouette on the windowsill, facing outside. A closed red umbrella with a curved brown handle leans beneath the window.

Foreground: an open cream-paper, gold-spiral notebook on a brown leather cover lies at lower left, with a dark green and gold fountain pen diagonally across the right page. Readable handwritten text says “CYP3A4” and “interaction risk”; the remaining small handwriting is illegible. At lower right, a white ceramic mug with delicate crack-like lines and a teal travel lid rests on a matching saucer. Eye-level perspective, richly detailed materials, restrained depth of field, soft volumetric light, warm amber illumination balanced against cool cyan and rainy blue tones, quiet futuristic scientific atmosphere.
